verdict.rationale: Sift is a SaaS fraud-detection platform with REST APIs (Events, Decisions, Score, Workflows), so scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack only describes sending data to Sift via REST APIs and SDKs. It says nothing about issuing API keys, scoping permissions, restricting keys by endpoint or action, or creating agent-specific credentials.
